servers.detail: Sony shut down DRIVECLUB / DRIVECLUB VR / DRIVECLUB Bikes servers on 31 Mar 2020 (announced Mar 2019; store delisting of games + all DLC/season passes on 31 Aug 2019). Offline/single-player and trophies for offline modes still work (gtplanet, pushsquare, gamesradar). All unearned VR trophies are offline (Tour/time trial/free drive), so the platinum is still obtainable.
